title: What If The Moon Disappeared Tonight?

scenes.narration: Tonight, the moon disappears. No explosion. It's just gone.
scenes.image_prompt: POV looking up at a night sky where the moon should be, empty dark space, people pointing, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: The first thing you'd notice: darkness. Real darkness. Every full moon night, gone forever.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a pitch black countryside at night, only stars visible, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: The tides shrink to about a third. Beaches change. Fishing towns wake up to boats on dry mud.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of fishing boats lying on mud at a harbor, confused fishermen, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Animals that hunt and breed by moonlight lose their clock. Coral reefs stop spawning together.
scenes.image_prompt: POV underwater at a coral reef in darkness, no spawning, still and silent, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: And slowly, over thousands of years, Earth starts to wobble on its axis.
scenes.image_prompt: POV from space of Earth slowly tilting, seasons drawn as shifting colors, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Seasons get wild. Ice ages, then heatwaves. The moon was holding us steady the whole time.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a landscape flashing between frozen tundra and scorching desert, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Would you rather lose the moon, or lose the stars? Comment moon or stars.
